content:
sarah: Quick sync — we need to lock the launch gates for the enterprise compliance bundle (audit logs + BYOK + SOC2). Customer pilots asking for commitments this quarter.
kevin: what's the minimal acceptance criteria we can ship without delaying the whole bundle?
maya: must-haves from security: automated BYOK handshake, tenant key scoping, and immutable audit stream for 90 days. No partials.
sarah: Agree on BYOK automation. For audit logs we could ship a 'sampling' mode first, but customers want searchable full streams for some pilots.
priya: Legal: pilots for finance customers need evidence export that preserves chain-of-custody. That implies export format + retention TTL controls.
leo: Engineering concern: full searchable streams for all tenants increases storage/cost x4. Can we offer a paid tier for hot search and a cold-archive for 90d?
kevin: That feels reasonable — define tiering in the SLA. Product asks: which of these are launch blockers vs. post-launch enhancements?
sarah: Launch blockers: 1) BYOK handshake (automated) 2) Evidence export with integrity checks 3) Retention configuration UI for tenant admins 4) SOC2 mapping doc + test plan.
maya: Non-blocker but high priority: indexable live search. We can ship with cold-archive + reindex job as interim.
priya: Legal also wants a fallback for legal-hold (override TTL) before GA. Can be gated behind enterprise contract but must exist.
leo: Technical note: BYOK escrow integration with customer KMS — need key rotation protocol + audit hooks. Estimate 3 sprints for end-to-end plus 1 sprint for tests.
kevin: If BYOK + export + TTL UI are blockers and take ~4 sprints, we should scope which customers get pilot access earlier.
sarah: Proposal: prioritize BYOK + evidence export + TTL UI for Q1 pilot; ship audit-search as opt-in paid feature in Q2 with reindex path. SOC2 doc must be ready before pilot.
sec-bot: deploy-batch: config rollout scheduled to beta orgs on 1839877000. :rocket:
maya: +1 to proposal. We should write explicit launch checklist items in the spec: acceptance tests, SLI targets, rollback plan, and billing meter for search.
priya: I'll draft contract language for legal-hold and evidence SLA.
kevin: I'll update the roadmap epic and ping infra about storage budget.
sarah: Great — can we reconvene Thurs 10am to sign off on the gates? If everyone OK I'll mark these as feature gates in the product spec. :thumbsup:
kevin: OK for Thurs. I'll bring cost estimates.
maya: I'll prep threat model notes and test cases.
priya: I'll share draft legal addendum by EOD Wednesday.
leo: I'll add BYOK tech design to the engineering doc and link infra tickets.
sarah: thanks — I'll turn this thread into the spec checklist and share a PR for review.
